name: FAQ, boxed accordion
description: Questions in rounded boxes that open one at a time with a plus and minus button.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Fourteen days, every feature, no credit card. Here is how the rest works.

default.question: How does the free trial work?
default.answer: You get every feature for 14 days and up to ten interviews. No credit card, and nothing is deleted when the trial ends.

default.question: Do you charge for every seat?
default.answer: Only for people who run interviews. Teammates who watch highlights and leave comments are free on every plan.

default.question: Can we change plans later?
default.answer: Upgrade or downgrade whenever you like. We prorate the difference on your next invoice.

default.question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits and schools?
default.answer: Yes, 40% off any plan for registered nonprofits, schools and universities. Write to us from your organization’s email.

default.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
default.answer: All major credit cards, and invoices paid by bank transfer on annual plans.
